name: Volume Trader
summary: This EA trades based on volume analysis, entering positions when unusual volume spikes are detected relative to a moving average of volume. It uses volume momentum as the primary signal generator to identify institutional activity and potential breakout moves.
summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量分析进行交易，当检测到相对于成交量移动均线的异常成交量飙升时入场。它利用成交量动量作为主要信号生成器，识别机构活动和潜在的突破走势。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于成交量异常来捕捉市场中的大资金动向。入场条件为当当前柱的成交量显著超过成交量移动均线的一定倍数时，视为有机构资金进场，顺势开仓做多或做空。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损，或当成交量回落至均值以下时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户设置固定手数或基于可用资金的百分比进行动态计算。资金管理方面，提供了止损参数来控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体账户级别的风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或最大持仓数限制。策略依赖单一指标（成交量），缺乏趋势过滤和确认机制，在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to capture large fund movements in the market based on volume anomalies. Entry conditions trigger when the current bar's volume significantly exceeds a multiple of the volume moving average, interpreted as institutional capital entering the market, and a position is opened in the direction of the momentum. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing when volume falls back below the average. Position sizing allows the user to set fixed lots or dynamically calculate based on a percentage of available equity. Money management provides stop-loss parameters to control per-trade risk, but lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or maximum position count restrictions. The strategy relies on a single indicator (volume) and lacks trend filtering and confirmation mechanisms, which may generate many false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单

pros: 成交量是市场最真实的指标之一，反映实际资金流动，较价格指标更具前瞻性
策略逻辑简单清晰，参数较少，易于理解和调优
能够捕捉大资金进场的时机，跟随机构方向交易具有概率优势
pros_en: Volume is one of the most authentic market indicators, reflecting actual capital flow and providing more forward-looking signals than price-based indicators
The strategy logic is simple and clear with few parameters, making it easy to understand and optimize
Capable of catching institutional entry timing, trading in the direction of large funds provides a probabilistic edge
cons: 仅依赖成交量单一指标，缺乏多维度确认，在低流动性市场中成交量信号不稳定
没有趋势方向过滤器，成交量飙升可能是双向的，容易在震荡行情中频繁止损
缺乏高级资金管理机制，如动态仓位调整、最大回撤保护、相关性风控等
cons_en: Relies solely on volume as a single indicator without multi-dimensional confirmation; volume signals can be unstable in low-liquidity markets
No trend direction filter; volume spikes can be bidirectional, leading to frequent stop-outs in choppy markets
Lacks advanced money management mechanisms such as dynamic position sizing, maximum drawdown protection, or correlation risk controls
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如均线方向或ADX）以确认成交量信号的方向性，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
加入多时间框架分析，在大周期趋势方向上只做顺势成交量突破交易，提高胜率
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., MA direction or ADX) to confirm the directionality of volume signals and reduce false signals in ranging markets
Incorporate multi-timeframe analysis, only trading volume breakouts in the direction of the higher timeframe trend to improve win rate

risk_points: 单一成交量指标在低流动性或异常成交量环境下可能产生错误信号
缺乏账户级别的风险控制，如最大同时持仓数和最大日亏损限制
risk_points_en: Single volume indicator may produce false signals in low-liquidity or anomalous volume environments
Lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum concurrent positions and maximum daily loss limits

summary_en: This EA trades based on volume analysis, entering positions when unusual volume spikes are detected relative to a moving average of volume. It uses volume momentum as the primary signal generator to identify institutional activity and potential breakout moves.
